At the event, some crooks pull guns on the gangster, and Darrell steps in to save his life. Frank then gives the DJ a job as his daughter's bodyguard, but, to the mobster's dismay, Dolly starts to fall for the smooth-talking Darrell. Their romance is interrupted when Frank gets involved in a mob war and drags Darrell along with him.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Europe
programme.desc: The story of Europe's living waters begins at great altitude. Melt waters from the highest snow-capped peaks feed some of the greatest rivers. On their relentless downward journey, streams and rivers have carved through all of Europe's greatest landscapes. Gorges, lakes and wetlands are home to an incredible array of wildlife and seas and oceans have sculpted a coastline of endless variety.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Islands
programme.desc: The Caribbean has been shaped by millions of years of unstoppable volcanic forces and ferocious hurricanes, creating a network of 7,000 islands, each one more unique than the next. From islets only a few miles long to landmasses with towering peaks, the habitats of this tropical paradise range from lush rainforests hiding untold species to multi-coloured coral reefs teeming with marine life.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Islands
programme.desc: Nestled alongside Canada's south west coast, Vancouver Island is home to the richest Pacific wildlife. Sea lions and killer whales are among the marine predators enjoying the abundant seafood in the surrounding waters, while black bears, marmots and beavers enjoy the rich pickings on land. But each fall, the islands inhabitants must adapt and prepare to face the coming winter. Some will leave, among them humpback whales and turkey vultures who migrate to warmer climes.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Islands
programme.desc: The Falkland Islands' pristine coastlines and bountiful seas offer a lifeline and breeding centre for millions of penguins each year. Though while some find sanctuary on dry land, there's a daily battle to survive in the waters which surround these wild and rocky shores.

programme.title: Destination Wild: Wild Madagascar
programme.desc: Millions of years ago, hundreds of castaway creatures crash-landed on Madagascar's rugged shores. Isolated from the mainland, evolution went into overdrive. Of almost a quarter of a million species found on the island are unique. This myriad of bizarre life forms had a huge impact on the early human settlers - one particular group of primates shaped their culture, fuelling folklore and legend that still guides their lives today. Limited Rights Available: Worldwide, Free TV Only

programme.title: Destination Wild - Desert Lands of the Middle East
programme.desc: Turkey sits on a jumbled collection of tectonic plates, whose collisions have created a tortuous landscape. In fact 80% of Turkeys terrain is rough, broken and mountainous. Mountain ranges both collect and block weather systems, affecting the climate across the country and producing huge contrasts between and within differing habitats.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Desert Lands of the Middle East
programme.desc: 96% of Egypt's lands are sun-blistered desert. Rock and sand dominate this country, creating a beautiful but hostile environment. Yet it was home to the Worlds greatest ancient civilisation, which flourished for millennia and still captivates us today. These harsh lands also hold amazing animals that can survive and even thrive, able to cope with and profit from the searing temperatures and lack of moisture.

programme.title: Destination Wild - India's Lost Worlds
programme.desc: The Western Ghats are amongst some of the most biodiverse regions in the world, and these mountains are the ancestral birthplace for many of India's endemic species. This episode delves into India's jungle heart, and the mysterious forests nestled in the shadow of the Western Ghats' great peaks. Amongst these trees lies the fabled world from the pages of history, and the character counterparts to the West's most cherished tales of India - Rudyard Kipling's 'The Jungle Book'.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Argentina
programme.desc: This episode follows the animals of Argentina, living life at the mercy of the Andean mountains. These peaks dictate a hard existence for every living creature from their summits to the very edge of the Patagonian steppe, forcing even the cutest resident to turn carnivore... Predators stalk the foothills and creepy crawlies lie low in the sandy steppe. Every animal here has a bloodthirsty drive to survive.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Argentina
programme.desc: Stretching almost 1000 miles, from the jungles of Brazil to the southernmost point of South America, Patagonia's coast is home to some of the natural world's most spectacular animals. Here, a parched desert collides with a powerful ocean, but right along this extreme and hostile coastline, animals battle the elements and each other, in a fight for survival.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Argentina
programme.desc: Argentina's northern territory contains one of the largest reserves in the country. Iberá is a vast expanse of swamps, marshes and lagoons, with a biodiversity count to rival the Pantanal. These lands are bursting with life, home to over 4000 animal and plant species. The rainy season in Iberá finds the wetlands in bloom... but unseen perils lurk beneath the surface, and even here, life can be a struggle for survival.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Colombia
programme.desc: Spanning the western length of Colombia, the Chocó region is thought to be one of most biodiverse places on the planet. When the Andes Mountains rose around 60 million years ago they isolated this wild coast creating a haven for evolution. It is the wettest place on earth, on average 13m of water falls every year. Combined with the varied topography of the Western Andes and the year round tropical heat, it is the perfect environment for species to adapt and evolve.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Colombia
programme.desc: In the middle of Colombia, lies an ancient, unique and little explored outcrop of sandstone; the Serrania de la Macarena. It forms part of the country's first ever national park - made up of lush jungle, shrubland and savannah, isolated peaks, winding rivers and spectacular waterfalls - where more than 15 million specimens were collected during early studies of the area. Called the 'treasure of the world', scientists believe it is a hugely important bank of biological diversity.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Colombia
programme.desc: Chiribiquete is an unknown world, hidden deep within Colombia's Amazon. Pre-historic towers, waterfalls and deep canyons lie surrounded by rivers, lakes and rainforests bursting with life. Scientists have only guessed at what else lies beneath this impenetrable pristine jungle - until now. Biologist Blanca Huertas from England's Natural History Museum, and Colombian-born nature photographer Francisco Forero, head deep into the heart of nowhere.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Europe
programme.desc: Over the last million years, our planet suffered a series of major ice-ages. Much of the northern hemisphere was covered in ice sheets several kilometres thick and creatures had no choice but to adapt or die. Over time, temperatures rose, causing these glaciers to retreat, however, in certain parts of Europe the ice-age never left. For many creatures, the struggle to survive 'a life below zero' continues.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Europe
programme.desc: Europe was once covered by forest, from the Arctic Ocean to the Mediterranean Sea. Wiped out in a mini ice age around 15000 years ago, they, and the wildlife that inhabit them are making a spectacular recovery. Today, Europe's forests cover around 1 000 million hectares (about 30 times the size of Poland).

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Europe
programme.desc: The story of Europe's living waters begins at great altitude. Melt waters from the highest snow-capped peaks feed some of the greatest rivers. On their relentless downward journey, streams and rivers have carved through all of Europe's greatest landscapes. Gorges, lakes and wetlands are home to an incredible array of wildlife and seas and oceans have sculpted a coastline of endless variety.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Islands
programme.desc: The Caribbean has been shaped by millions of years of unstoppable volcanic forces and ferocious hurricanes, creating a network of 7,000 islands, each one more unique than the next. From islets only a few miles long to landmasses with towering peaks, the habitats of this tropical paradise range from lush rainforests hiding untold species to multi-coloured coral reefs teeming with marine life.

programme.title: Destination Wild - Wild Islands
programme.desc: Nestled alongside Canada's south west coast, Vancouver Island is home to the richest Pacific wildlife. Sea lions and killer whales are among the marine predators enjoying the abundant seafood in the surrounding waters, while black bears, marmots and beavers enjoy the rich pickings on land. But each fall, the islands inhabitants must adapt and prepare to face the coming winter. Some will leave, among them humpback whales and turkey vultures who migrate to warmer climes.

His sole friend is Abby (Chloë Grace Moretz), a strange girl who comes out only at nighttime. Both outcasts, the two form a strong bond. When Abby's caretaker disappears amid a series of gruesome murders, Owen begins to suspect that she is hiding a terrible secret.

An unusual zombie named R (Nicholas Hoult) sees his walking-dead brethren attacking a living woman named Julie (Teresa Palmer) and rescues her. Julie sees that R is different from the other zombies, and the pair embark on an unusual relationship. As their bond grows and R becomes more and more human, a chain of events unfolds that could transform the entire lifeless world.

programme.title: The Hunger Games
programme.desc: In what was once North America, the Capitol of Panem maintains its hold on its 12 districts by forcing them each to select a boy and a girl, called Tributes, to compete in a nationally televised event called the Hunger Games. Every citizen must watch as the youths fight to the death until only one remains. District 12 Tribute Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) has little to rely on, other than her hunting skills and sharp instincts, in an arena where she must weigh survival against love.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: After arriving safely home from their unprecedented victory in the 74th Annual Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) discover that they must do a quick turnaround and begin a Victors Tour. As she and Peeta travel throughout the districts, Katniss senses a rebellion is stirring. However, President Snow (Donald Sutherland) proves that he is still very much in control when word comes of a cruel change in the rules for the upcoming 75th Hunger Games.

programme.title: The Best of Enemies
programme.desc: The true story of the unlikely relationship between Ann Atwater, an outspoken civil rights activist, and C.P. Ellis, a local Ku Klux Klan leader. During the racially charged summer of 1971, Atwater and Ellis come together to co-chair a community summit on the desegregation of schools in Durham, N.C. The ensuing debate and battle soon lead to surprising revelations that change both of their lives forever.

programme.title: Draft Day
programme.desc: Sonny Weaver Jr. is the general manager of the Cleveland Browns. One of pro football's most important days, NFL draft day, is drawing near, but Sonny has much more on his mind than just which players to recruit. His lover is pregnant, and the team's owner wants to fire him. After Sonny accepts a deal with Seattle that nets him that team's first-round pick, he immediately wonders if he has made the right choice for himself and the Browns.

programme.title: Buried
programme.desc: A civilian truck driver in Iraq, Paul Conroy (Ryan Reynolds) falls victim to a band of insurgents. An unknown length of time later, Paul awakes in a coffin, with little more than a lighter, a cell phone, and his ever-growing anxiety. Faced with a dwindling oxygen supply and a dying battery, Paul must fight panic, despair and delirium as he awaits a rescue that might not arrive in time.

programme.desc: For best friends Becky and Hunter, life is all about conquering fears and pushing limits. However, after they climb 2,000 feet to the top of a remote, abandoned radio tower, they find themselves stranded with no way down. Now, their expert climbing skills are put to the ultimate test as they desperately fight to survive the elements, a lack of supplies, and vertigo-inducing heights.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS gets into the Christmas spirit at New Hampshire's Christmas Farm Inn. Gary Plourde, the owner, gives the guys the tour and shares some of the reported activity. The stories range from apparitions and footsteps, to the sounds of children playing and the feeling of being watched. Jason and Grant start out the night in the Carriage House spa and start to hear some footsteps around them.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS investigates the entire town of Alexandria, Louisiana, where paranormal activity seems to lurk around every corner. The first stop on their paranormal tour is the Hotel Bentley, where among other reports, disembodied conversations are heard, and a little girl trips people on the stairs. The next stop is Finnegan's Wake Tavern, where there are reports of shadows moving, loud bangs coming from upstairs, and a glass breaking on its own.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Chester County, Pennsylvania to investigate the Pennhurst Asylum. Pennhurst was forcibly shut down in 1986 for mistreatment of patients, overcrowding and abuse. Some of the claims are screams being heard, people being pushed, doors opening and closing on their own, shadows, and apparitions.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Oxford, Massachusetts to help a family in need. The house has been in the Voas family for two generations, and lots of activity has been reported, from apparitions and shadow figures to footsteps and conversations. A braid of hair and shoe were also found in the basement during renovations.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to America's most haunted city, New Orleans, to investigate the Old U.S. Mint. This mint-turned-museum has lots of reported activity, including shadow figures, thuds, noises, female apparitions, lights flickering and alarms going off. Steve and Tango start off their night on the second floor. While the guys are walking around a door suddenly opens and then slams shut all on its own, leaving the guys speechless.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode on Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to South Dakota for the first time to investigate the Alex Johnson Hotel, a place filled with history. Some of the paranormal activity reported are apparitions, voices, objects being moved, growling sounds, and a story of a bride to be either being killed or committing suicide. The TAPS team also welcomes Maddie, the ghost-hunting dog.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson are two plumbers working for Roto-Rooter in New England. They are also the co-founders of TAPS - The Atlantic Paranormal Society - a paranormal research team which investigates hauntings and other strange occurrences.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Prospect, Maine to investigate Fort Knox, built before the Civil War to protect the Penobscot narrows. Some of the reported activity has been sounds of stones skipping, doors opening, apparitions, and a strong feeling of evil being felt. Britt is back with the TAPS team and the guys get set up. Jason and Grant start in Long Alley, and the guys see something strange appear on the thermal camera.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Worcester, Massachusetts to investigate the Higgins Armory, the only armory in the western hemisphere devoted to arms and armor. Some of the activity that has been reported is loud knocking, banging, footsteps, music, doors opening/closing, and the apparition of the former owner. Jason and Grant get started in the Quest Gallery, and they see a chain moving on its own.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, Taps heads to Derby, Connecticut to investigate one of the country's oldest Opera houses, the Sterling Opera House. Some of the reported paranormal activity is a woman in white, as well as a gentleman in a period suit, and shadows. Some believe the Opera House's builder Charles Sterling haunts it, because he died two years before the building was complete.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels for the first time to Hawaii to investigate the Pacific Aviation Museum at Pearl Harbor in Honolulu. Steve can't fly, so he isn't able to make the trip, but Britt is helping out, as well as Destination Truth's Josh Gates. Some of the activity that has been reported is whispers, cold air being felt, apparitions, and cameras being turned on and off on command.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Last time on Ghost Hunters, the team was in Hawaii investigating the Pacific Aviation Museum with special guest Josh Gates, when Steve called Jason with an urgent personal case back in Rhode Island that involves a terrified 4 year old. Jason and Grant hop the first flight back, and meet up with Steve at TAPS headquarters to get the low down on this next case. While there they conference in to do the reveal back in Hawaii with Tango and Amy.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team travels to New Castle, Pennsylvania to investigate Hill View Manor. Before closing in 2004, this old nursing facility had many reports of death by suicide. Some of the paranormal claims by staff members includes unexplained reflections, voices, full body apparitions, shadow figures, the sounds of machines, and people seeing a little boy known as Jeffrey. After seeing Jeffrey, the patients would soon pass away.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS becomes the first paranormal group to investigate Seaview Terrace in Newport, RI. Built in 1923 by the Bradley family, Seaview Terrace is recognizable from TV's "Dark Shadows" which filmed there in the 1960's. Some of the reported activity includes an apparition of Mrs. Bradley, voices, feelings of being watched, seeing faces, and the temperature fluctuating. Jason and Grant start out in the Great Hall and try to get Mrs.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Townsend, Massachusetts to investigate the Townsend Historical Society's two houses; the Reed Homestead and the Spaulding Cooperage. The main goal is to help staff not be afraid of paranormal activity that seems to be taking place at both properties. Built in 1809, the Reed Homestead was home to four generations of the Oliver Reed family. One of Oliver Reed's four daughters, Hannah, hanged herself after the death of her young daughter.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to the Carnegie Library Homestead, in Homestead, Pennsylvania. This Library was the site of violent riots between Carnegie and the steel workers. It is said that Carnegie built the library to win the steel workers over. It is thought that steel workers or Carnegie himself could be haunting the building. Some of the reported activity includes shadow figures, books falling off shelves, apparitions, and voices.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Hawaii's Plantation Village, which was once a sugar plantation. It it is now an outdoor museum with reports of spirits still wandering the property and the many authentically replicated homes. It is believed that some of the entities seen are those who committed suicide or were murdered.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS and Jason's daughter, Haily, head to Napanoch, New York to investigate the Shanley Hotel. Since its opening in 1845, The Shanley Hotel has been plagued by an abundance of inexplicable deaths and tragic events targeting children. One of these tragic stories involved a little girl named Rosie, who died as she fell down a well while playing with friends. Some of the reports are of apparitions and toys moving in various rooms of the hotel.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS becomes the first paranormal team to ever investigate the historic Friars Club in New York City. Built in 1904 and famous for its roasts, TAPS has been brought in to find out if comedian, Al Kelly, is behind all the activity. There have been reports that an old man can be heard grunting, cold air surrounding someone, lockers moving, shadows, and apparitions of a man sitting at a table.

Hoping to find out from Gauche where the gang buried their spoils before Kuroda can kill him, Link tries to escape from the samurai.

After shooting down his wife and her lover, he battles a landowner intent on keeping all the town's water for himself. But his deadly ways make him yearn for a belief in God again.

programme.sub-title: On Land in the Air and All at Sea: January-March 1941

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Prefabricated concrete barges are manufactured in preparation for D Day. U.S. troops storm a beach in a practice landing assault. How harbor facilities made in England were used in the Normandy invasion. A storm damages the harbor but unloading continues.
programme.sub-title: Newsreel Reports on Preparation for D-Day

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Invasion of Southern France by the 7th army and subsequent junction with the American 3rd army in northwest part of France.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: In 1930s Germany, the Nazi Party created the Hitler Youth to indoctrinate children and adolescents with Nazi ideology and prepare them to become a child army for Hitler. This episode traces the rise of the movement, from early everyday life indoctrination, through to the war.
programme.sub-title: The Hitler Youth: Nazi Child Army

programme.title: D-Day: 100 Days for Freedom
programme.desc: June 6, 1944-150,000 Allied soldiers land on Normandy's shores in Operation Overlord, one of history's largest military campaigns. Through rare colorized archives and personal testimonies, this episode relives the chaos, courage, and tragedy of D-Day, as the Allies fight to secure a foothold in occupied France.

programme.title: The Vietnam War: The Invisible Enemy
programme.desc: The second part of the story of the Vietnam War from the perspective of both sides, including rare war time footage from North Vietnamese sources.

programme.title: The Crusade in Europe
programme.desc: Americans arrive in Britain, try to get along with the British civilians, and are made ready physically and mentally to fight the Germans. The Eighth Air Force begins its bombing offensive, and the decision is made to invade French North Africa.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: Sergeant Cleo Lehenbauer, nicknamed 'Indestructible,' is wounded during the 101st Airborne's D-Day jump and after being hospitalized returns to Normandy. In September, he walks through a mine infested field and rescues two comrades in Holland. After conflicts with his commander in the 5th Armored Division, he transfers back to the 101st, where he helps stop the last major German offensive.

programme.title: U.S. Marines in Vietnam
programme.desc: The Fall of Saigon occurred on April 30, 1975 when the South Vietnamese government announced its unconditional surrender to North Vietnam. As a line of tanks smashed through the gates of the presidential palace, Vietcong troops rounded up government soldiers, and raised their red and blue flags. The United States Embassy remained under control of the U.S. Marines.

programme.title: U.S. Marines in Vietnam
programme.desc: The 3rd Battalion, Ninth Marines wading ashore 10 miles west of Da Nang in March 1965 marked the beginning of the Corps commitment to the war in Vietnam. This is the story of why they were called in and their first actions against the Viet Cong. The Battalions initial orders read in part ...to conduct security missions, reconnaissance operations, and offensive operations as directed.

programme.title: Nazi Death Marches: 1944-1945
programme.desc: Through exclusive film archives and written journals, we will reveal a lesser known chapter of the end of the Third Reich, a story of brutality and murder. In the final months of World War II, 700,000 prisoners were evacuated from concentration camps and traveled throughout Europe. 250,000 to 300,000 died from exhaustion or were massacred by the guards or even civilians in Austria and Germany.

programme.title: Auschwitz - Voices of 44 Survivors
programme.desc: End of the 1930s, in Occupied Europe. From one day to the next, young men, women and their families found themselves excluded, persecuted, hunted down and arrested, simply for being Jewish. They would soon be deported far from home, to a place that became the ultimate symbol of horror: Auschwitz, Nazi Germany's largest concentration and extermination camp.

programme.title: Night Swallows
programme.desc: Evgeniya 'Zhenya' Zvonareva, lead pilot of the female aviation regiment, receives the Order of Kutuzov for destroying Sturmbannführer Neumann's camp. However, the victory owed to friend Galya Shevchenko, once the top night bomber, now demoted to mechanic after tribunal. Zhenya must destroy an enemy ammo-and-fuel depot; a sabotage team led by Captain Aleksandr Makeev will join.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: Hitler, Göring, and Himmler shared a strange obsession with animals, using them as propaganda tools, symbols of ideology, and even weapons of war. Far beyond affection, their fascination fueled pseudo-scientific projects and genetic manipulation. Through archives, expert insight, and re-enactments, this documentary uncovers how the Nazis exploited nature to serve their brutal vision.

programme.title: Jets
programme.desc: The air war in Vietnam was unlike any other. It was the full might of the world's greatest military power pitted against an elusive, but highly motivated enemy. From an air combat perspective, the Vietnam War provided the superpowers, the US and the USSR, with the opportunity to put their best technology, and weapons systems, into the sky to fight it out.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Gen. Eisenhower addresses troops in Southern England; the 'Big Show' begins; airborne troops dropped behind enemy lines; support aircraft drop everything from howitzers to motorcycles; bombers blast bridges and supply lines; sea forces bombard enemy fortifications on French coast; British and second army swarm over coast at Omaha and Utah Beaches; German west wall broken.
programme.sub-title: D-Day - The Battle in the Air

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: On 30 January 1933, Hitler became chancellor and the Nazis quickly seized state power. Foreign diplomats in Berlin, turned into spies and whistleblowers, witnessed both Nazi infiltration of high society and the exclusion of Jews. Drawing on rare archives, this documentary reveals their warnings about the rise of National Socialism-and how the world ignored them.
programme.sub-title: Ambassadors in Berlin: The Whistleblowers of WWII

programme.title: WWII: On the Edge of the Abyss
programme.desc: 1943 marks the turning point in the war, as the Allies open new fronts. The invasion of Italy, the battle for Stalingrad, and the island-hopping campaigns in the Pacific begin to turn the tide. This episode shows how ordinary soldiers endured unimaginable hardships, and how the Axis powers started to suffer significant losses, signaling the beginning of their decline.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: Ewald von Kleist has broken through to the Terek river, slap in front of the vital oil fields of Grozny and Baku. Only freezing temperatures in the Caucasus prevent von Kleist's 1st Panzer Army from breaking through to Ozoni Kizi and Tbilisi. The Soviets launch a desperate counter-attack that holds the Germans back.

programme.title: WWI The War To End All Wars - Part 1: The Valley of Death
programme.desc: June 1914, Europe was in the midst of an idealic summer. The nations of Europe were joined together by webs of trade and capital. Their royal houses linked by bonds of family and marriage. Global trade was at an all time high. The prospect of all an all out European war was unthinkable, pundits said. No one saw the catastrophe coming, until it came. World War I - The War to End All Wars.

programme.title: Modern Warfare: Wars in the Middle East Collection
programme.desc: Iraq's 1990 invasion of Kuwait resulted in more than one million troops facing off against each other in the desert of the Persian Gulf. The Allied Coalition's air war, known as Operation Desert Storm, involved the most sophisticated technological weaponry available.
programme.sub-title: Modern Warfare: The Persian Gulf War - Part 2

programme.title: Late War Fighters of the Luftwaffe
programme.desc: Hitler was losing the war in 1944. In the East, Russians rolled forward relentlessly, threatening the existence of Hitler's Third Reich. Hitler knew that if he were to survive, he needed a miracle. New technologies, or miracle weapons, could turn the tide of war. Against all odds, German engineers not only designed but produced in good numbers some of the best aircraft of the war, the ME262.

programme.title: The Death Train
programme.desc: this film revisits the first massive crime of WWII killing 13,000 people in the city of Lasi, Romania that lays out the early stages of the Shoah. This is possible thanks to unique archives - including unpublished photographs - and interviews of the last survivors.

programme.title: WWII: Mysteries in the Archives 1938-1948
programme.desc: On June 6, 1944, the Normandy Landings, officially called Operation Overlord, began. This massive battle was also the largest media operation ever, with hundreds of reporters capturing footage under heavy fire. Among the first waves on beaches like Juno, Omaha, and Utah, these brave photographers shaped our collective visual memory of World War II.

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets

programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Amsterdam

The story is set up to create a taut cat-and-mouse game between Griffin and FBI agent Joel Campbell.

programme.title: Dead Silence

Once there, he discovers the legend of Mary Shaw (Joan Heney), a murdered ventriloquist whose eerie presence still looms over the town. As he desperately digs for answers, Jamie encounters the curse that took his wife's life and threatens his own.

programme.title: The Unborn

programme.title: The Forest

Accompanied by expatriate Aiden, she enters the mysterious wilderness after being warned to "stay on the path." Her investigation plunges her into a dark world where the angry and tormented souls of the dead prey on those who dare to explore the forest.

programme.title: Slither

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Cuando los Casillas van a darle el último adiós a Doña Alba y "El Pulque", les tienden una trampa, atrás quedan las balas, el fentanilo es protagonista.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio confirma la muerte de su madre y se entera de que Luzma está grave. "Uña de tigre" le cuenta sobre el intento de asesinato múltiple en el funeral de Doña Alba, "Pío" lideró el ataque.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio Casillas es el Señor de los Cielos, va y viene del más allá cuando quiere y planta cara ante sus aliados. Don Julio daba por desaparecida a "La Soberana", ahora le da la bienvenida.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Llenas de incredulidad, las especulaciones brotan por todos lados y a Ismael le toca la peor parte, recibe una visita que lo conmueve y lo enfurece. La orden de un juez llega al hospital.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Corina descubre el proyecto secreto con el que se fabricó la supuesta muerte de Aurelio Casillas, llamado "Código Lázaro". Ismael sorprende a Rutila, quien confundida reclama y se conmueve.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El video de vigilancia del hospital es una prueba de vida de Aurelio Casillas para Alfaro, pero a Manzano y a Colón no les convence. Corina confiesa su amor por el Señor de los Cielos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Las sospechas señalan a Corina Saldaña como la infiltrada, su puesto en la DEA pende de un hilo. Aurelio Casillas se acerca a ella para saber si es cómplice de la estrategia de enterrarlo vivo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El destino los une otra vez, "La Felina" no puede creer lo que ve con sus propios ojos y sin perder un segundo coloca dos toneladas de droga, una conexión directa entre México y Venezuela.
programme.sub-title: La mejor defensa es el ataque

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: En el funeral de Luz Marina Casillas, Aurelio jura venganza por las mujeres que marcaron su vida. El responsable de la muerte de su hija y de su madre la va a pagar. Alex no es quien dice ser.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Jaime piensa en la forma de eliminar todo lo que haya en la memoria de Berenice, tal vez provocar un suicidio lanzándola por el balcón. Diana está muy preocupada por ella.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le propone a Diana que se entregue a las autoridades de Estados Unidos y aunque al principio parece una broma, ella tiene que confiar en él, todo está coordinado con Corina.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tracy Lobo tiene el poder y su intención es usarlo en contra de Mecha, haberla desafiado le va a costar caro. Rutila enfurece con la idea de entregar a Diana a la DEA, es demasiado el riesgo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Caridad se siente atraída por Aurelio y "La Felina" le da un buen consejo, pero ella no la escucha. Carla y Corina comparten información confidencial. Jaime exige "desconectar" a Bere.
programme.sub-title: Soy el señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio paga la fianza de Mecha y, al salir, ella no puede parar de hacerle preguntas, pero la prioridad es saber quién es él. Se muerde los labios, ella está tentada a decirle la verdad.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Zambrana ya ha esperado demasiado y exige a Fernando que atente contra la vida de Ismael, es hora de liquidarlo. "Vitaminas" identifica a Tracy Lobo, espera la orden de Casillas para disparar.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Antes de enfrentar a los atacantes de Ismael, Aurelio le pide a Corina que lo acompañe, aunque no les conviene que los vean juntos. "La Felina" se une a los Casillas con armas y hombres.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio reúne a la familia y ordena mantenerse alertas, después de la masacre. Rutila le hace una advertencia a su padre que no tiene vuelta atrás. Casillas ya sabe cómo rescatar a Bere.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Diana, aún consciente de provocar un disgusto, le pone a Aurelio Casillas una condición de último minuto antes de entregarse a la DEA. Roberta le confiesa a Mecha su atracción por las mujeres.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas le ordena al gobernador, Jaime Rosales, parar el operativo de la DEA e impedir la extradición de Diana. La detenida recibe una oferta de Alfaro que implica una traición sin medida.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Una banda de criminales busca a Mecha para borrarla del mapa, al enterarse de que es ella quien ayuda a los migrantes a huir. "Vitaminas" le informa a Casillas que su mujer está bajo amenaza.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Corina roba información, tiene una pista que es clave para Aurelio y sus deseos de venganza; él no deja de pensar en Mecha, cree que ella es la indicada, tiene en mente viajar a Mexicali.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Las cosas van demasiado lejos, Corina sufre por Aurelio, pero lo prometido es deuda. Fernando allana el terreno con Rutila, va de frente y una rosa roja le arranca una sonrisa al día siguiente.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Paco demanda a su expareja por plagio, alega que le robó una aplicación para encuentros de tríos. Bruno exige que su esposa Helena desaloje a su familia y a su ex, que los trajo sin avisarle.

programme.title: Caso Cerrado
programme.desc: Miembros de la iglesia católica debatirán los asuntos actuales que han surgido en los medios desde la controversia del Padre Alberto.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El trabajo de Juan es calentar a los actores porno antes de grabar; su esposa quiere el divorcio. Andrés descubre que su hija es fruto de una infidelidad; quiere dejar a su esposa y a la niña.
programme.sub-title: Marido fluffer; Hija enferma de otro

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Yudi abandona a su familia para ganar una competencia, su esposo le exige que se ocupe del niño. Loreta demanda a su esposa porque quiere someterse a un suicidio asistido e involucra a su hijo.
programme.sub-title: Que esposa regrese a Venezuela; Hijo sugiere eutanasia para mamá

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Julio quiere el divorcio y la custodia de su hijo, la madre usa al niño para recaudar dinero en internet. Pablo e Iñaki contratan a una madre subrogada, ahora se divorcian y no saben qué hacer.
programme.sub-title: Niño con bola en cuello falsa; Adopción gay

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Yenni exige la aprobación de su esposo para dar en adopción a su hija que tiene una grave malformación. Pedro demanda a su empleadora, quien lo incitó a masturbarse ante la cámara y luego lo despidió.
programme.sub-title: El hombre con la cabeza atrás; Fotos con orgasmos

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Marlene aprueba que los maestros porten armas, su esposo no, ella quiere el divorcio y la custodia de su hija. Sasha pide la emancipación de sus gemelas, alega que ya no puede controlarlas.
programme.sub-title: Maestros armados; Gemelas de 17 casarse con tercero

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Melissa es pintora y tiene nueve años, afirma que su padre la explota, quiere vivir con su abuela. Ana pide que sus cuñados se ocupen de su suegra, perdió la razón y ella no puede cuidarla.
programme.sub-title: Niña pintora, padre abusador; ¿Qué hacemos con María desnuda?

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Ana se casó con Juan, su suegro, para obtener la residencia. Además, una bebé murió ahogada por su hermana mayor. La madre culpa al padre porque, mientras ocurría la tragedia, el hombre estaba teniendo sexo con la niñera que debía cuidar a las niñas.
programme.sub-title: Me casé con suegro x papeles; Bebé muere asfixiada

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.sub-title: Asilo de viejos gozando; Beba no quiere medula de mamá

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.sub-title: Mata puercos; Adicta a ser bebé

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Ángela crea un tratamiento para rejuvenecer y el principal ingrediente es sangre de ratas; su arrendador la demanda. David demanda a su esposa; descubrió que los gemelos que adoptó tienen sida.
programme.sub-title: Sangre de rata rejuvenece; Hijastros con sida

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Carla no soporta que su padre le fuera infiel a su madre, le exige que deje la casa y se divorcie. Nataly demanda a su hermana por acusarla falsamente de acoso sexual; quiere 50 mil dólares.
programme.sub-title: Odio a papá por poner cuernos; Whatsapp dudoso testigo

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Lucía demanda a su madre, asegura que malgasta su herencia en pagarle a su exnovio por su compañía. Liz descubre que su padre es gay y está enamorado de su hermano adoptivo, quiere desalojarlo.
programme.sub-title: Madre renta novio de hija; Padre gay, hermano gay

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Andrés quiere la custodia de su hermanita de ocho años; su madre la sometió a una cirugía plástica. Carlos quiere cortarse el miembro; su esposa Fabiola exige que se someta a terapia psicológica.
programme.sub-title: Cirugías plásticas para niños; Odio a mi penecito

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La esposa de Osmany quiere el divorcio, su cuñada, que reconozca a su hija y la mantenga, y su suegra, lanza una acusación. A Cintia le encanta el sexo oral, pero su esposo ya no puede más.
programme.sub-title: Tres mujeres para un hombre; Bajar a la fuente

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Cristian pide la custodia de su hijo, la mamá trata la diabetes del niño con saliva de reptil. José quiere desalojar a Valerie, estudiante venezolana de acogida, ella lo acusa de estafador.
programme.sub-title: Gila Lizard Monster; Trampa a estudiantes Venezuela

programme.desc: Christian demanda al amante de su mujer, lo acusa de dañar su relación incitándolo a usar un roedor. Carlos pide ayuda para su esposa, descuida su embarazo por su hija mayor que está en coma.
programme.sub-title: Ratoncito explorador; Hija en coma, madre embarazada

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.sub-title: Lesbiana tía hermana del muerto; Fantasías con la Dra. Polo

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies dance around the trees and watch some children drum with their friend Norris. Tinky Winky dance on the roof of Home Hill and wakes up the other Tubbies.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: In Teletubbyland, the Tubbies are trying to be quiet. They watch Oscar read the story of the Gingerbread Boy to his brother Felix. A voice trumpet appears and sings the nursery rhyme.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
